## GET /v1/bestbuy/product - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Best Buy US product by its product link: the product id, name, brand, image and the price in US dollars, with the regular price when the item is on sale. `product.ext.bestbuy` adds the numeric SKU and, with store_id, the store's pickup state.

**Use when** you want to check the current price of a Best Buy product whose link you already have.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - The product's link on bestbuy.com, for example https://www.bestbuy.com/product/lg-65-class-nu700b-series-led-nano-ai-4k-uhd-smart-webos-tv-2026/JJ8VPZK46Q. It is the address of the product's own page on bestbuy.com. · e.g. `https://www.bestbuy.com/product/lg-65-class-nu700b-series-led-nano-ai-4k-uhd-smart-webos-tv-2026/JJ8VPZK46Q`
- `store_id` (optional, string) - Best Buy store id (digits, for example 1019) whose prices and pickup state to read. product.ext.bestbuy.store_id names the store the row is from.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.description` | Product description. |

+8 more (types in the full schema): `product` {image_urls, reviews_count}; `product.ext` {bestbuy}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.seller`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bestbuy/product" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.bestbuy.com/product/lg-65-class-nu700b-series-led-nano-ai-4k-uhd-smart-webos-tv-2026/JJ8VPZK46Q" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## Withdrawn endpoints (do not call)

These stay registered but return `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` today and never bill. A permanent withdrawal is not coming back - use the alternative named in the platform's other endpoints rather than retrying.

- `GET /v1/bestbuy/search` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
